prompt_text:
Continue the text below with exactly one short, natural, coherent English sentence. Return only the continuation, with no preamble or explanation:
All of the "#1 Dad" mugs in the world change to show the actual ranking of Dads suddenly.

When I wake up every morning, my daily ritual is to watch the 6 o'clock news.  When I turned on the news, the first story detailed a weird phenomenon that seemed to be happening around the world.  Dads around the world were watching their #1 Dad mugs change to different, seemingly random numbers right in front of their eyes.        

The news anchor was doing the story from a studio in New York and as soon as he started talking about the phenomenon, the mug on his desk changed to "#500,000,000 Dad".  He looked down at his mug and was startled a bit.  However, he was a professional and continued to do the segment.
reference_text:
The news organization had interviewed a woman who said he was responsible for the changing mugs.

She used a powerful spell that would reveal how good the dad's around the world actually were.   Just as the woman was about to explain the spell, she was interrupted by a mug that changed in her hand.
